source.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is edit target: actual transparent crocodile parts texture atlas1254x1254. Keep canvas dimension, all16sprite placements, scale, colors, realistic crocodile scales, alpha and every limb/head/jaw unchanged. Change ONLY firstrow firstcolumn torso and secondrow thirdcolumn long tapered tail. The current torso rear-left and tail root-right show a bright rounded cap/rim making the assembled tail look detached. Repaint those two connector surfaces as uninterrupted dark olive golden crocodile skin: natural consistent scale sizes, no bright bevel rim, no flat chopped face, no pale cut surface, no outlined seam, no isolated bulb or spherical cap. Torso rear-left connection needs taper smoothly with organic rounded overlap into a tail base; tail right root should be a dark natural scaley rounded overlap, unoutlined, compatible color/light with torso rear. Preserve the outer outline and exact sprite pixel positions as closely as possible so bindings stay compatible; repaint local material transition, not restructure atlas. The torso center and dorsal scutes remain. Taper tail smoothly to its left tip. Maintain actual transparency outside all sprites. DO NOT add legs/head to torso, no labels, gridlines, scenery, text, castshadows or opaque backdrop. All other14pieces exactly invariant. Goal source-art seam repair, not a new character.
